contracts.signal: Enflame's prospectus: Tencent Technology (Shenzhen) bought AI accelerator cards and modules worth RMB 10 thousand 76,811.89 directly, 74.90% of Enflame's 2025 revenue; with sales through Tencent-designated server makers (AVAP mode) the Tencent total was 82,965.20, 83.79% of revenue (37.77% in 2024, 33.34% in 2023), and Tencent was the largest end customer in every year. The two have worked together since 2019; Tencent's demand for accelerator cards far exceeds Enflame's current supply capacity, and Enflame expects Tencent's high share to continue for some time. Prices to Tencent are lower than to non-related third parties.
